description: Western Province - Notification Made Under Section 66(c) First meeting of 21 Local Government Institutions.
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the schedule for first meetings to elect Mayors/Chairmen and Deputy Mayors/Deputy Chairmen for various Local Government Authorities in the Western Province. It falls under the Elections category as it specifically deals with electoral processes for local government positions, is made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, and provides detailed schedules for election-related meetings.
